lines.text_source: We're finally back on board... Those pirates have a high price to pay.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Finalmente estamos de volta... Esses piratas vão pagar caro por isso.

lines.text_source: A flying iron castle! How is that possible?
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Um castelo de ferro voador! Como é possível?

lines.text_source: We don't have time to explain the history of our evolution to you, so please try to concentrate on the mission.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Não temos tempo de explicar a história de nossa evolução, então concentre-se na missão.

lines.text_source: Of course...
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Claro...

lines.text_source: Now, listen closely. The pirates have disabled almost all of the module's systems but, thanks to that orb, you'll be able to clear a path for yourself by recharging different circuits. However, even with the orb, there will still be disabled doors that you'll only be able to open with positively charged vimana minerals. You'll need to find the four generators.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: give mission briefing with technical details
lines.base_translation: Agora, escute bem. Os piratas desativaram quase todos os sistemas do módulo, mas, graças àquele orbe, você conseguirá abrir caminho recarregando diferentes circuitos. Porém, mesmo com o orbe, ainda haverá portas desativadas que só poderá abrir com minerais vimana carregados positivamente. Você precisará encontrar os quatro geradores.
lines.risk_notes: Technical jargon (orb, circuits, vimana minerals, generators) — maintain clarity for gameplay.

lines.text_source: Try starting with the entrance door. After that, I'll provide you with the minerals.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Comece pela porta de entrada. Depois, vou lhe fornecer os minerais.

lines.text_source: Gentlemen, have you finished? While you were talking, I had an idea. I could scout ahead with Irka and try to find the best routes to reach those generators.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Cavalheiros, terminaram? Enquanto conversavam, tive uma ideia. Eu poderia explorar na frente com Irka e tentar encontrar as melhores rotas pro esses geradores.

lines.text_source: You would have to be able to fly to allow us access. Nearly all the conduits are closed off right now.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Você teria que ser capaz de voar pra nos dar acesso. Quase todos os condutos estão fechados agora.

lines.text_source: You don't know how happy it makes me that you've said that, he, he, he...
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Você não faz ideia de quanto isso me deixa feliz, hehe...

lines.text_source: Get ready to be amazed. I've been keeping this trick up my sleeve for just this type of situation.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Prepáre-se para se surpreender. Guardei esse truque pra uma situação exatamente assim.

lines.text_source: I've never been one for magic, but Irka was blessed with this power when we arrived here.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Nunca fui chegado em magia, mas Irka foi abençoada com esse poder quando chegamos aqui.

lines.text_source: Absolutely speechless, aren't you? I imagined as much...
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Vocês estão sem palavras, né? Imaginei que seria assim...

lines.text_source: Ah, your dog has wings...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Ah, seu cachorro tem asas...

lines.text_source: Your horse has wings. Proceed with your reconnaissance mission. Inform us if you find something.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Seu cavalo tem asas. Prossiga com sua missão de reconhecimento. Nos avise se encontrar algo.

lines.text_source: I was hoping for a bigger reaction, to be honest...
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Eu esperava por uma reação maior, pra ser honesto...

lines.text_source: Alright, I shan't hang around any longer. I'm off.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Tá bom, não vou ficar aqui perdendo tempo. Tou indo.

lines.text_source: Stay alert, I'll be back to let you know what I've found.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Fiquem alertas, vou voltar pra avisar o que achei.

lines.text_source: We are inside. That gate is code-operated. Just a moment...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Estamos dentro. Aquele portão é acionado por código. Um momento...

lines.text_source: Well done! We have restored basic systems in this area. Use the transporter to proceed on your path.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: confirm progress and enable next step
lines.base_translation: Muito bem! Restauramos os sistemas básicos nesta área. Use o transportador pra prosseguir.

lines.text_source: Here are the positively charged vimana minerals. Remember, you must place them in the four generators in order to gain access to the main control room.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Aqui estão os minerais vimana carregados positivamente. Lembre-se, você deve colocá-los nos quatro geradores pra ganhar acesso à sala de controle principal.

lines.text_source: We are counting on you. Strength, human!
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Contamos com você. Força, humano!

lines.text_source: Make way for the great Euder!
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Lugar pra o grande Euder!

lines.text_source: Hello again, my little friend.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Oi de novo, meu pequeno amigo.

lines.text_source: Have you seen just how amazing this machine is? And they say they don't use magic! I wonder how they keep it floating...
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Você viu como essa máquina é incrível? E falam que não usam magia! Fico imaginando como eles mantêm isso flutuando...

lines.text_source: Ah, I almost forgot amongst all the excitement. I've located the generators. Unfortunately, without that toy of yours, no one can access them. Give me your map, I'll mark their whereabouts for you.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Ah, quase esqueci na empolgação. Localizei os geradores. Infelizmente, sem aquele brinquedo seu, ninguém consegue acessá-los. Me dá seu mapa, vou marcar onde eles estão.

lines.text_source: You'll thank me when we're back on terra firma.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Você me agradece quando voltarmos pra terra firme.

lines.text_source: Since we're up in the air, I'm going to take the opportunity to have a look good at the area. I'm sure General Brigard will find it useful to have an idea of what surrounds us in this world.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Como a gente tá no ar, vou aproveitar pra dar uma olhada boa na região. Tenho certeza que o General Brigard vai achar útil ter ideia do que nos rodeia nesse mundo.

lines.text_source: Be good and, above all, be careful. It looks like this air pirate thing is no joke. There's a flying boat that's keeping them anchored.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Comportem-se bem e, acima de tudo, fiquem atentos. Parece que esse negócio de pirata aéreo é coisa séria. Tem um navio voador que os tá mantendo ancorados.

lines.text_source: We're off! Giddy up, Irka!
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Vamos! Anda, Irka!

lines.text_source: Magnificent and shining refined crystal... It's taken three days but, finally, you have the right energy grade.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Cristal refinado, magnífico e brilhante... Levou três dias, mas finalmente você tem o grau de energia certo.
lines.risk_notes: NPC 'Birk' appears to be antagonist; maintain formal-solene tone; preserve contempt/triumph.

lines.text_source: With you, we'll conquer the skies, just as it always should have been.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Com você, conquistaremos os céus, como sempre deveria ter sido.

lines.text_source:
Steel armour...
Ragged garments...
Swords, staffs and arrows...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: describe humans with disdain via enumeration
lines.base_translation: Armadura de aço... Roupas esfarrapadas... Espadas, cajados e flechas...

lines.text_source: You Humans are primitive to the point of boredom.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Vocês humanos são primitivos a ponto de ser entediante.

lines.text_source: I don't understand how these Croma have managed to ally with something to uninteresting. They must be desperate.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Não entendo como esses Croma conseguiram se aliar com algo tão desinteressante. Devem estar desesperados.

lines.text_source: I'm sorry to tell you that, while you've managed to get this far, there is nothing you can do. We have full control of the module.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Sinto ter de dizer, mas enquanto conseguiram chegar até aqui, não há nada que possam fazer. Temos controle total do módulo.

lines.text_source: Although...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Porém...

lines.text_source: Did you think I wouldn't notice that you had this on you? Its shine is hypnotising, isn't it?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Você pensava que eu não notaria que tinha isso com você? Seu brilho é hipnotizante, né?

lines.text_source: I'll take this. Just in case, you know?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Vou pegar isso. Só pra garantir, sabe?

lines.text_source: If I were you, I'd go. It's not a good idea to stay somewhere like this. Who knows how long it'll be before it comes crashing down?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Se fosse você, ia embora. Não é boa ideia ficar num lugar desse. Quem sabe quanto tempo falta pra isso cair?

lines.text_source: Listen to me and go back to your village, Human. Otherwise, things will end badly for you.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Me escuta e volta pra sua aldeia, humano. Senão, as coisas vão acabar mal pra você.

lines.text_source: You've been warned.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Você foi avisado.

lines.text_source: Str... th... Hum...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: For... ça... Hum...

lines.text_source: Human, can you hear me? Is this working?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Humano, você consegue me ouvir? Tá funcionando?

lines.text_source: I'm speaking to you through the communicator.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Tou falando com você pelo comunicador.

lines.text_source: It looks like you've just meet the pirates' leader.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Parece que você acabou de conhecer o líder dos piratas.

lines.text_source: But, without those vimana minerals, you won't be able to reactivate the different sectors within the module. Blast... those were all we had to hand.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Mas, sem esses minerais vimana, você não conseguirá reativar os diferentes setores do módulo. Droga... eram tudo que tínhamos à mão.

lines.text_source: Wait, tell me you've kept the <color=OBJ>negatively polarised minerals</color>. Yes, the red ones you found in the generators.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Espera, me diz que você guardou os <color=OBJ>minerais polarizados negativamente</color>. Sim, os vermelhos que encontrou nos geradores.
lines.risk_notes: Color tag <color=OBJ>negatively polarised minerals</color> must be preserved verbatim; critical gameplay instruction.

lines.text_source: Good! You Humans are more astute than the commander expected.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Ótimo! Vocês humanos são mais astutos do que o comandante esperava.

lines.text_source: I can restore their original polarity in the testing room so that they start to generate energy again.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Posso restaurar a polaridade original deles na sala de testes pra que voltem a gerar energia.

lines.text_source: I'm going there now. If you carry on, you'll be able to find it.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Tou indo pra lá agora. Se você continuar, consegue achar.

lines.text_source: I'll wait for you there. Over and out.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Vou te esperando lá. Fim.

lines.text_source: I see you managed to arrive without issues, though I'm not particularly surprised at this point.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Vejo que conseguiu chegar sem problemas, apesar de eu não estar particularmente surpreso nesse ponto.

lines.text_source: We must hurry. Give me the minerals and I'll restore them, though I should tell you that the process will take some time. Best be patient.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Temos que nos apressar. Me dá os minerais que vou restaurá-los, mas devo avisar que o processo vai levar tempo. É bom ter paciência.

lines.text_source: How does this work...?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Como isso funciona...?

lines.text_source: Don't worry, I've seen the process a thousand times. I'll manage, I just need to focus.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Não se preocupa, vi o processo mil vezes. Consigo, só preciso focar.

lines.text_source: Well..._100_ done._100_ What a splendid catch.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Bem..._100_ feito._100_ Que captura esplêndida.
lines.risk_notes: Token _100_ appears twice; must preserve exact count and position. Mysterious 'Dark Claw' antagonist — maintain ominous, formal tone.

lines.text_source: I think I'll share this feast with you._100_ Would you..._100_ like that?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Acho que vou compartilhar esse festim com você._100_ Você..._100_ gostaria?
lines.risk_notes: Token _100_ appears twice; must preserve exact count and position. Ominous invitation — maintain sinister formality.

lines.text_source: Was it you..._300_ or me...?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Era você..._300_ ou eu...?
lines.risk_notes: Token _300_ appears once; must preserve exact position. Philosophical/ominous question — maintain ambiguous, formal tone.

lines.text_source: Phew, I've done it! I knew I could, you had nothing to fear!
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Ufa, consegui! Eu sabia que conseguia, você não tinha nada a temer!

lines.text_source: Hmmm?_100_ Are you alright?_100_ You look exhausted.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: checking on player's condition with concern
lines.base_translation: Hmmm?_100_ Você está bem?_100_ Parece exausto.

lines.text_source: You've been practicing so you can kill that rat, haven't you?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Você vem treinando pra conseguir matar esse rato, certo?

lines.text_source: You should save your energy, I don't think it'll be easy to carry on from this point.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Conserve sua energia. Daqui pra frente não será fácil.

lines.text_source: Keep them safe, I don't know where we'll get more if you lose them.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Cuide deles. Não sabemos onde achar mais se perder.

lines.text_source: Strength, Human.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Força, Humano.

lines.text_source: Who...? Who are you...?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Quem...? Quem é você...?
lines.risk_notes: identity unclear—respond to tension, not reveal speaker identity

lines.text_source: Are you here to finish us off now that we're weakened?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Veio nos rematar agora que estamos fracos?

lines.text_source: It's alright, he's not one of those pirates. He's with me. He's called Human.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: introducing and vouching for player to subordinate
lines.base_translation: Está tudo bem, não é um dos piratas. Está comigo. Chama-se Humano.

lines.text_source: Commander...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Comandante...

lines.text_source: I know what you're thinking. I know they don't look much, but they've proven themselves to be a fierce ally, believe me.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: defending player's worth to skeptical subordinate
lines.base_translation: Sei o que pensa. Sei que não parecem muito, mas provaram ser aliados ferozes. Acredite em mim.

lines.text_source: That's not what I was going to say, Commander. I'm sorry that they were able to take over the Module so easily.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: apologizing for module breach and tactical failure
lines.base_translation: Não era isso, Comandante. Sinto que conseguiram tomar o Módulo tão fácil.

lines.text_source: It must have been hard resorting to help from such a primitive race.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: expressing shame at needing primitive help
lines.base_translation: Deve ter sido difícil recorrer a uma raça tão primitiva.

lines.text_source: No need to apologise. The spineless attack carried on us by those vermin took us all by complete surprise.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Sem necessidade. O ataque covarde desses vermes nos pegou completamente de surpresa.

lines.text_source: You've arrived just in time. We've retreated to this point to launch a surprise counterattack, but those birds are sharp-witted. They surrounded us and blocked off the air ducts. We thought we wouldn't survive to tell the tale.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: explaining tactical situation and narrow escape
lines.base_translation: Chegou na hora certa. Recuamos até aqui pra um contra-ataque de surpresa, mas esses pássaros são astutos. Nos cercaram e bloquearam os dutos de ar. Pensávamos não viver pra contar.
lines.risk_notes: longer line; verify fit in byte_budget (227 vs transliterated length)

lines.text_source: You know the circumstances our species find itself in. It is imperative that we survive at all costs.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Conheces a situação em que nossa espécie se encontra. É imperativo que sobrevivamos a qualquer custo.

lines.text_source: The one who appears to be their leader is on the rear deck. I don't know what he's been doing, but he seems to be plotting something.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Quem parece ser o líder deles está no convés de trás. Não sei o que anda fazendo, mas parece estar tramando algo.

lines.text_source: We will not let him escape, but I need you all to get to safety first.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: ordering subordinates to safety while blocking escape
lines.base_translation: Não vamos deixá-lo escapar, mas preciso que todos se coloquem em segurança primeiro.

lines.text_source: So, you're still here...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: mocking player for still being on the ship
lines.base_translation: Então, ainda está aqui...

lines.text_source: Didn't I tell you it was dangerous to stay on this piece of junk?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: reminding player of earlier warning with contempt
lines.base_translation: Não avisei que era perigoso ficar nesse ferro velho?

lines.text_source: The party's over. We've already taken everything of value to us, so I don't plan on staying another minute on this trash heap.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: announcing theft complete and imminent departure
lines.base_translation: A festa acabou. Já levamos tudo que tinha valor pra gente, então não pretendo ficar mais um segundo nesse lixo.

lines.text_source: Although... you've already taken a fair few blows, perhaps I could try out my new energy source on you.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: threatening to test new power on weakened player
lines.base_translation: Mas... você já levou uns bons golpes, talvez pudesse testar minha nova fonte de energia em você.

lines.text_source: Don't take it personally, Human.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Não leve pra lado pessoal, Humano.

lines.text_source: UNLIMITED POWER!
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: exclaiming about newfound power with manic joy
lines.base_translation: PODER ILIMITADO!

lines.text_source: Our potential will be infinite from now on!
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Nosso potencial será infinito daqui pra frente!

lines.text_source: Don't be afraid, I'll be quick.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Não tenha medo, vou ser rápido.

lines.text_source: How can this be?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Como é possível?

lines.text_source: How can someone like you defeat the Pirates of the Broken Wing?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: expressing disbelief at player defeating pirate crew
lines.base_translation: Como alguém como você derrota os Piratas da Asa Quebrada?

lines.text_source: Today was supposed to be the start of our great destiny...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Era pra ser o começo do nosso grande destino...

lines.text_source: Grrr... Your people have earnt a place on our list of enemies. One day we'll pillage and plunder you, just for fun. Enjoy your victory, bumpkin.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: swearing revenge while grudgingly accepting defeat
lines.base_translation: Grr... Seu povo entrou na nossa lista de inimigos. Um dia vamos saquear e pilhar vocês, só pela zoação. Aproveita a vitória, caipira.
lines.risk_notes: threat/revenge vow; 'bumpkin' is contempt—use 'caipira' or reformulate

lines.text_source: Have no fear, for the cavalry is here!
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Não tenham medo, a cavalaria chegou!

lines.text_source: Never better said, right?
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.intent: asking for agreement/validation of witty remark
lines.base_translation: Nunca foi dito melhor, né?

lines.text_source: What has happened? Where is that vermin?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: asking what happened and where enemy went
lines.base_translation: O que aconteceu? Onde está esse verme?

lines.text_source: I see, he has fled with his tail between his legs. He is lucky that our priority now is to repair our systems.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: observing cowardly retreat while prioritizing repairs
lines.base_translation: Entendo, fugiu com a raba entre as pernas. Sorte que agora nossa prioridade é reparar os sistemas.

lines.text_source: In the name of the Croma survivors of Floating Module Gamma, we are eternally indebted to the soldiers of Zarga. From now on, your hunt shall be our hunt.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: formally pledging eternal alliance with Zarga
lines.base_translation: Em nome dos sobreviventes Croma do Módulo Flutuante Gama, somos eternamente gratos aos soldados de Zarga. De agora em diante, vossa caça será nossa caça.
lines.risk_notes: formal ceremony language; long line—verify fit; 'hunt shall be our hunt' idiom

lines.text_source: As agreed, you may keep the ray orb.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Como combinado, podem ficar com o orbe de raio.

lines.text_source: You may keep the electric orb.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Podem ficar com o orbe elétrico.

lines.text_source: Gentlemen, gentlemen...
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.intent: calming exaggerated formal tension with levity
lines.base_translation: Cavalheiros, cavalheiros...

lines.text_source: No need to thank us. Zarga always takes on danger in the name of justice... though celebration is most welcome.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.intent: deflecting thanks while promoting Zarga ideology
lines.base_translation: Sem necessidade de agradecer. Zarga sempre enfrenta o perigo em nome da justiça... mas celebração é bem-vinda.

lines.text_source: You have done a lot for us. You may use any of our transporters to leave the ship at any time, and you're free to return whenever you like.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: offering free transport and permanent access to ship
lines.base_translation: Vocês fizeram muito por nós. Podem usar qualquer um de nossos transportadores pra deixar a nave quando quiserem, e são livres pra voltar quando quiser.

lines.text_source: Thanks for the invitation, but we have a Guardian to find.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.intent: politely declining offer due to mission urgency
lines.base_translation: Obrigado pelo convite, mas temos um Guardião pra encontrar.

lines.text_source: Guardian?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Guardião?

lines.text_source: Didn't those Valkyries task you with the same mission?
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.intent: asking if Commander received same mission from Valkyries
lines.base_translation: Aquelas Valquírias não te deram a mesma missão?
lines.risk_notes: spoiler potential—Valkyries' involvement; asking if Commander knows about mission. Monitor for reveal timing.

lines.text_source: As I said, we came to this world on our Floating Module. There is much about it that we simply do not know.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: explaining limited knowledge due to ship arrival
lines.base_translation: Como disse, chegamos neste mundo com nosso Módulo Flutuante. Há muito que simplesmente não sabemos.

lines.text_source: So it seems all of us are the weird ones around here, then.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.intent: wryly observing that everyone is equally confused
lines.base_translation: Parece que todos aqui somos os estranhos, então.

lines.text_source: Never mind.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Deixa pra lá.

lines.text_source: Soldier, we should head back. While I was flying above this machine, I noticed an interesting area beyond the swamp to the east.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.intent: suggesting departure and new exploration direction
lines.base_translation: Soldado, devíamos voltar. Enquanto eu sobrevoava essa máquina, notei uma área interessante além do pântano a leste.

lines.text_source: I'd like to explore it and deliver a full report of our adventures to General Brigard.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.intent: expressing intent to explore and report to General
lines.base_translation: Quero explorar e entregar um relatório completo das nossas aventuras pro General Brigard.

lines.text_source: Whad'ya say? Shall we go for one last ride? Promise to get you home in time for dinner!
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.intent: playful challenge inviting player to ride with false promise
lines.base_translation: E aí? Vamos dar mais uma volta? Prometo te levar em casa na hora do jantar!

lines.text_source: Yes! I know I could count on you.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.intent: celebrating player's agreement with emphatic confidence
lines.base_translation: Sim! Sabia que podia contar com você.

lines.text_source: Alright, let Irka work his magic.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.intent: inviting player to mount flying companion with light magic phrasing
lines.base_translation: Tá bem, deixa o Irka trabalhar sua mágica.

lines.text_source: Now, hop on!
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Agora, salta pra cima!

lines.text_source: Humans, one last thing...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Humanos, uma última coisa...

lines.text_source: The beings you defeated in the city are what brought us here. Be extremely careful; they're more dangerous than you could ever imagine. There are sure to be more out there.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: warning about previously encountered enemies and future danger
lines.base_translation: Os seres que vocês derrotaram na cidade é o que nos trouxe aqui. Tenham muito cuidado; são mais perigosos do que poderiam imaginar. Com certeza há mais aí.
lines.risk_notes: reveals enemy type (creatures from city); significant lore/spoiler context. Back-translation required.

lines.text_source: Of course. We're off; let us know if those pretentious pigeons try to mess with you again. We'd be happy to beat them back again.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.intent: acknowledging warning and confidently offering further help
lines.base_translation: Claro. Vamos indo; nos avisa se aqueles pássaros pretenciosos tentarem mexer com você de novo. Ficaríamos felizes de bater neles de novo.

lines.text_source: Strength, Human.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Força, Humano.

lines.text_source: Giddy up!
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Partiu!

lines.text_source: I can't see much further ahead thanks to the gases in this area. I'm willing to bet there's something around here of use to our search.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.intent: observing environmental obstacle and speculating about loot
lines.base_translation: Não consigo ver muito mais pra frente por causa dos gases nessa área. Aposto que há algo por aqui de uso pra nossa busca.

lines.text_source: We're about to arrive.
lines.speaker: Euder
lines.base_translation: Estamos prestes a chegar.

lines.text_source: Str... th... Hum...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: For... ça... Hum...
lines.risk_notes: truncated speech (Str...th...Hum...) suggests injury/weakness; preserve fragmentation in translation

lines.text_source: Pay attention, Human. What you see before you is one of the four generators we need to restart in order to access the control room.
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: Preste atenção, Humano. O que você vê diante de si é um dos quatro geradores que precisamos reiniciar para acessar a sala de controle.
lines.risk_notes: Geradores/Sala de Controle são conceitos do mundo; verificar consistência com glossário expandido se existir. 'Four generators' = 4 geradores confirmados.

lines.text_source: In order to insert the <color=OBJ>positively polarised mineral</color> into the generator, we first need to supply it with energy.
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: Para inserir o <color=OBJ>mineral com polaridade positiva</color> no gerador, precisamos primeiro fornecer energia a ele.
lines.risk_notes: Termos técnicos (positively polarised mineral, generator) mantêm semântica; reformulação concisa necessária para respeitar byte_budget de 130 (pt-BR ~20% maior que EN).

lines.text_source: Try to restore power to it by using the <color=OBJ>Electric Orb</color>.
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: Tente restaurar a energia dele usando o <color=OBJ>Orbe Elétrico</color>.

lines.text_source: Strength, Human. Over and out.
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: Força, Humano. Fim da transmissão.
